def max_beauty(n, s, b):
    from collections import Counter
    
    # Count the frequency of each character in s
    freq = Counter(s)
    
    # Create two lists to store characters with odd and even frequencies
    odd_freq_chars = [char for char, count in freq.items() if count % 2 == 1]
    even_freq_chars = [char for char, count in freq.items() if count % 2 == 0]
    
    # Sort the beauty values in descending order
    b.sort(reverse=True)
    
    # Initialize the maximum beauty
    max_beauty = 0
    
    # Assign the highest beauty values to characters with odd frequencies
    for i in range(len(odd_freq_chars)):
        max_beauty += b[i]
    
    # Assign the remaining beauty values to characters with even frequencies
    for i in range(len(even_freq_chars)):
        max_beauty += b[len(odd_freq_chars) + 2 * i]
    
    return max_beauty
